issue.body:
### What happened?

IREE throws an error stating that `all constant resources must have the same lifetime` when compiling the training step for a simple hotword model:

```mlir
/tmp/iree/hotword/hotword_pooled_dnn.mlir:10:10: error: all constant resources must have the same lifetime
    %0 = mhlo.constant dense<[...]> : tensor<16x5xf32>
         ^
/tmp/iree/hotword/hotword_pooled_dnn.mlir:3:3: note: called from
  func.func @train_step(%arg0: tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>, %arg1: tensor<1x2xf32>, %arg2: tensor<1xi16>) {
  ^
/tmp/iree/hotword/hotword_pooled_dnn.mlir:10:10: note: see current operation:
  %2:3 = "stream.resource.constants"(%0, %1) {values = [dense_resource<__elided__> : tensor<16x5xf32>, dense_resource<__elided__> : tensor<10x12xf32>]} : (index, index) -> (!stream.resource<constant>, !stream.resource<variable>, !stream.timepoint)
    %0 = mhlo.constant dense<[...]> : tensor<16x5xf32>
         ^
compilation failed
```

### Steps to reproduce your issue

The following is a simplified version of the MLIR that causes the error:

```mlir
module @hotword {
  ml_program.global private mutable @_mdl_vars$0(dense<""> : tensor<10x12xf32>) : tensor<10x12xf32>
  func.func @train_step(%arg0: tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>, %arg1: tensor<1x2xf32>, %arg2: tensor<1xi16>) {
    %0 = ml_program.global_load @_mdl_vars$0 : tensor<10x12xf32>
    %1 = call @jit__train_step$main(%arg0, %arg1, %0) : (tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>, tensor<1x2xf32>, tensor<10x12xf32>) -> tensor<10x12xf32>
    ml_program.global_store @_mdl_vars$0 = %1 : tensor<10x12xf32>
    return
  }
  func.func private @jit__train_step$main(%arg0: tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>, %arg1: tensor<1x2xf32>, %arg2: tensor<10x12xf32>) -> tensor<10x12xf32> {
    %0 = mhlo.constant dense<[[0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00], [0.679073572, 0.320926428, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00], [0.000000e+00, 0.79708755, 0.202912465, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00], [0.000000e+00, 0.149625719, 0.850374281, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.637809753, 0.362190247, 0.000000e+00], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.214530602, 0.785469412, 0.000000e+00], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.8536278, 0.146372229], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.539056659, 0.460943311], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.260263443, 0.739736557], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.00993347074, 0.990066528], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.782791138], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.574901104], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.38325429], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.205494881], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.0397461243], [0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00, 0.000000e+00]]> : tensor<16x5xf32>
    %1 = call @jit__train_step$_einsum(%0, %arg0) : (tensor<16x5xf32>, tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>) -> tensor<1x2x5x1xf32>
    %9 = mhlo.reshape %1 : (tensor<1x2x5x1xf32>) -> tensor<1x10xf32>
    %14 = mhlo.constant dense<1.000000e+00> : tensor<f32>
    %22 = "mhlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%14) {broadcast_dimensions = dense<> : tensor<0xi64>} : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<1x12xf32>
    %23 = call @jit__train_step$_einsum_1(%9, %22) : (tensor<1x10xf32>, tensor<1x12xf32>) -> tensor<10x12xf32>
    %44 = mhlo.add %arg2, %23 : tensor<10x12xf32>
    return %44 : tensor<10x12xf32>
  }
  func.func private @jit__train_step$_einsum(%arg0: tensor<16x5xf32>, %arg1: tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>) -> tensor<1x2x5x1xf32> {
    %0 = mhlo.convert(%arg1) : (tensor<1x2x16x1xi16>) -> tensor<1x2x16x1xf32>
    %1 = "mhlo.dot_general"(%0, %arg0) {
      dot_dimension_numbers = #mhlo.dot<lhs_contracting_dimensions = [2],
      rhs_contracting_dimensions = [0]>,
      precision_config = [#mhlo<precision DEFAULT>, #mhlo<precision DEFAULT>]
    } : (tensor<1x2x16x1xf32>, tensor<16x5xf32>) -> tensor<1x2x1x5xf32>
    %2 = "mhlo.transpose"(%1) {permutation = dense<[0, 1, 3, 2]> : tensor<4xi64>} : (tensor<1x2x1x5xf32>) -> tensor<1x2x5x1xf32>
    return %2 : tensor<1x2x5x1xf32>
  }
  func.func private @jit__train_step$_einsum_1(%arg0: tensor<1x10xf32>, %arg1: tensor<1x12xf32>) -> tensor<10x12xf32> {
    %0 = "mhlo.dot_general"(%arg1, %arg0) {
      dot_dimension_numbers = #mhlo.dot<lhs_contracting_dimensions = [0],
      rhs_contracting_dimensions = [0]>,
      precision_config = [#mhlo<precision DEFAULT>, #mhlo<precision DEFAULT>]
    } : (tensor<1x12xf32>, tensor<1x10xf32>) -> tensor<12x10xf32>
    %1 = "mhlo.transpose"(%0) {permutation = dense<[1, 0]> : tensor<2xi64>} : (tensor<12x10xf32>) -> tensor<10x12xf32>
    return %1 : tensor<10x12xf32>
  }
}
```

The error can be reproduced by using `iree-compile` on any backend:

```shell
iree-compile \
  --iree-hal-target-backends=vmvx \
  --iree-input-type=mhlo \
  /tmp/hotword_pooled_dnn.mlir \
  -o /tmp/hotword_pooled_dnn.vmfb
```
